description: Controlled vocabulary for ForAI discovery facets. Topics are concise discovery labels; use cases describe tasks; audiences describe likely practitioners. Facets are hints, not endorsements or compatibility guarantees.

verification_level_notes.historical-link-check: A numeric HTTP response was recorded historically; it is not a current reachability check.
verification_level_notes.historical-notes: Historical discovery or review notes exist, but this label does not assert a recent URL check.
verification_level_notes.not-recorded: No verification scope was recorded in the source fields.
verification_level_notes.page-fetch-or-source-check: Review notes record a page fetch or scoped primary-source inspection; this is not a full adoption audit.
verification_level_notes.repository-metadata: Repository API metadata was checked; this does not mean README, license, security, or compatibility were audited.
verification_level_notes.source-excerpt-reviewed: A README or source excerpt was reviewed for limited metadata; this does not establish suitability.
verification_level_notes.user-submitted: Added from a user-provided URL and not independently checked.

project_identity.github: GitHub owner/repository normalized to lowercase; used to link multiple catalog entries for the same repository.
project_identity.manual: Non-GitHub endpoints listed explicitly in project-groups.json; do not merge distinct URLs into one resource record.
